nodes.label: Edit Drawer (right-side panel)
nodes.rationale: A right-side drawer is the modern best practice for editing a record you are looking at; create keeps the centered modal. Shared inner markup extracted into deviceFormInner for one source of truth. The drawer keeps the dialog-scrim/dialog classes (adding drawer variants only for positioning) so dialog.js needs no change.

nodes.label: dialog.js Modal Controller
nodes.rationale: Loaded once by Layout; uses event delegation on document so it works for fragments injected after load. Handles scrim/Escape/data-close dismissal and the icon-picker interaction.

nodes.label: Occupied Square Popup Open/Edit Actions
nodes.rationale: CellDetail gains Open (navigate to detail) and Edit (hx-get the edit drawer into #modal, replacing the popup) so a device can be edited in place from the grid.

nodes.label: Free Grid Square Opens Prefilled New Device
nodes.norm_label: free grid square opens prefilled new device
nodes.rationale: A free square becomes a button opening the New-device dialog prefilled with that IP and subnet (preIP threaded through deviceFormInner); edge squares stay inert because network/broadcast are not assignable. Prefill is presentational — create validation unchanged.

nodes.label: Toast Feedback System (#toasts, ScanToast)
nodes.rationale: The toast is 'started' feedback, not completion tracking — completion still flows through the existing SSE refresh which updates counts and the grid live. Buttons post with hx-target #toasts / hx-swap beforeend; toasts.js auto-dismisses and guards a missing container. The buffered trigger channel absorbs rapid clicks so no rate-limit UI.

nodes.label: CellDetail Popup
nodes.rationale: Clicking an assigned square opens a modal-shell popup (IP, device link, current lease, Set static / Set DHCP); the device-to-square navigation moves into the popup so nothing is lost by dropping the direct anchor. The toggle publishes grid:{id} over SSE so the open grid reloads with the flipped border.

nodes.label: Transactional Migrate Loop (FK-off rebuild)
nodes.rationale: SQLite cannot ALTER a CHECK constraint, so widening device.source requires a table rebuild; DROP TABLE with foreign keys on would cascade-delete every child table's rows. PRAGMA foreign_keys cannot change inside a transaction, so FK toggling wraps the whole migration pass; per-migration foreign_key_check aborts on dangling references. Safe because migrations run once at startup on the single pooled connection.

nodes.label: Router & Modem Device Kinds
nodes.rationale: Widening the kind CHECK requires the same table-rebuild idiom as migration 0002, so the two new columns ride the same rebuild.

nodes.label: shouldRunScan Manual-Bypass Guard
nodes.rationale: 2-state scan model, no migration: scan_enabled now means periodic auto-scan; a manual Scan-now always works for any non-WireGuard subnet regardless of the flag (manual-only mode = auto off + click). The manual/auto distinction lives entirely in the scheduler, keyed off which select case fired, so the trigger channel carries no flag and Trigger's signature is unchanged. WireGuard subnets are never ARP-scannable.

nodes.label: Proxmox Integration
nodes.rationale: Poller upserts VMs/LXCs as devices with parent_device_id pointing at the node's device; a stopped guest is shown as stopped, not spammed as offline events.

nodes.label: integration_status Table
nodes.rationale: Migration 0003; one upsert row per background loop (names exactly proxmox, wireguard, pihole, scan) recording last run, ok flag, detail, item count.

nodes.label: Needs-Attention Panel
nodes.rationale: Surfaces unknown scan-sourced devices (unknown- name prefix) and IP conflicts (Occupant.Count > 1) as actionable links.

nodes.label: Scan Engine and Scheduler
nodes.rationale: Per-subnet scan loops with diff logic; online/offline state derives from MarkSeen/MarkMissed with an offline_after missed-sweep threshold.

nodes.label: SQLite Store with Embedded Migrations
nodes.rationale: modernc.org/sqlite (pure Go) with SetMaxOpenConns(1) to avoid SQLITE_BUSY; migrations embedded and tracked in schema_migrations.

nodes.label: templ + HTMX + SSE Stack
nodes.rationale: Server-rendered templates with HTMX fragments and SSE live updates keep the app no-build and JS-light.

nodes.label: WireGuard SSH Sync
nodes.rationale: Peer status read by SSHing into the WireGuard host and parsing 'wg show dump' rather than a local integration.

nodes.label: Manual Scan Bypasses Auto-disable
nodes.rationale: Scheduler guard split so manual Trigger scans work on subnets with periodic auto-scan off; WireGuard subnets always skipped.

nodes.label: Integration Status Cards
nodes.rationale: Presentation-only: settings Integrations tab shows connected/failing + last-worked + detail from the already-recorded IntegrationStatus; field markup split into per-integration templs so the onboarding welcome page renders unchanged.

nodes.label: recordStatus/runAndCount Pattern
nodes.rationale: Each sync's Start loop calls recordStatus(runAndCount(ctx)) so Start and tests share exactly one code path; emits one scan_error event per outage and publishes the dashboard SSE topic after every run.

nodes.label: Single Go Monolith Architecture
nodes.rationale: All state lives in one SQLite file behind a store package; scanning, integrations, and web layers only talk to the store and the event service. Ships as a single static CGO-free binary with no external services.

nodes.label: SSE-refreshed Dashboard Fragment
nodes.rationale: The dashboard body becomes one fragment (GET /dashboard/widgets) re-fetched on sse:dashboard and sse:events triggers, assembled entirely from the store.

nodes.label: SSE Event Broker
nodes.rationale: Publish is non-blocking and drops messages to slow subscribers (buffered chan 16); grid refresh uses topic grid:<subnetID>.

nodes.label: DeviceDrawer Edit Drawer
nodes.rationale: Refactors the device form into a shared deviceFormInner; the drawer variant reuses the dialog class hooks so dialog.js stays untouched.

nodes.label: LeaseToggle (per-IP static/dhcp)
nodes.rationale: Reusable templ + POST /devices/{id}/ip/kind handler wired into the device page IP table.

nodes.label: DeviceDialog Modal Fragment
nodes.rationale: Templ fragment injected via HTMX into a persistent #modal div; plain POST to existing handlers whose 303 redirect reloads the page and dismisses the modal.

nodes.label: Grid Square Click: New/Edit/Open Device
nodes.rationale: Free squares open a New-device dialog prefilled with IP+subnet (preIP threaded through handleDeviceForm/deviceFormInner); occupied squares' CellDetail popup gains Open and Edit actions.

nodes.label: CellDetail Popup
nodes.rationale: Assigned squares are buttons opening a modal fragment whose Set-static/Set-DHCP buttons POST to a handler that updates ip_assignment.kind and republishes grid:{id} SSE.

nodes.label: Full-range Occupancy Grid v2
nodes.rationale: scan.AllIPs returns network..broadcast; gridCells maps each address to a state (edge for network/broadcast) with lease-aware squares: fill = liveness, border = static/dhcp.

nodes.label: Shared subnetCard Templ
nodes.rationale: Dashboard's subnet-row loop extracted into subnetRows() and its card markup into subnetCard so the new GET /subnets page reuses the same occupancy computation and markup.

nodes.label: CSS Design Token System
nodes.rationale: Components style through CSS custom properties only — never redefined inside media queries — so both themes stay in sync and explicit data-theme always wins over the OS preference in both directions. Dark palette must stay identical in three places (media query, data-theme=dark, data-theme=light re-assert).

nodes.label: New-Subnet Defaults (general settings)
nodes.rationale: Chose three practical fully-wired defaults (interval/kind/auto-scan) over instance-name branding, which would require threading a value through every Layout call site. Auto-scan uses a select rather than a checkbox so the field is always submitted and never ambiguously absent. New keys persisted only when present, keeping older callers/tests unaffected.

nodes.label: netdetect Subnet Auto-Detection
nodes.rationale: Pure package with an injectable interface-lister seam for tests (no real host networking). Filters down/loopback/link-local/host-route addresses and virtual interface prefixes (docker, veth, br-, tap, cni, virbr). Dedupe against already-configured subnets is the caller's job, keeping the package pure and independently testable.

nodes.label: Tabbed Settings Page
nodes.rationale: Server-rendered tabs (subnets/integrations/users/general, unknown falls back to subnets) so the long stacked page shows one section at a time; each POST redirects back to its own tab.

nodes.label: First-Run Welcome Wizard (onboarded gate)
nodes.rationale: Gated by an 'onboarded' setting checked in requireAuth: the redirect survives a restart mid-wizard and prevents landing on an empty dashboard. A GetSetting error is treated as not-onboarded (fails safe). Invalid CIDRs are skipped so one typo doesn't block the batch.

nodes.label: Onboarding Shell + 3-Step Stepper
nodes.rationale: A shared branded shell (Account/Subnets/Integrations stepper on a soft accent backdrop) used by Setup and both Welcome steps; presentation-only — every endpoint, view signature, and form field name is unchanged so handlers and existing tests still work. Token-driven, CSP-safe (no external assets).

nodes.label: Per-Integration Field Templs (welcome-preserving)
nodes.rationale: integrationsFields is shared with the onboarding welcome page, which must keep plain fieldsets; splitting into proxmoxFields/wireguardFields/piholeFields keeps the field names byte-identical for both pages and the save handler untouched, while settings wraps each in a status-carded header.

nodes.label: Settings Tab Templs + Setting Cards
nodes.rationale: SettingsPage split into four focused tab templs dispatched by ActiveTab; presentation-only rework — every POST endpoint and field name unchanged, secrets still render blank.

nodes.label: Pi-hole v6 API Client
nodes.rationale: Auth is internal: POST /api/auth caches session.sid, sent as X-FTL-SID header, with a single re-auth retry on 401.

nodes.label: Pi-hole Sync Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Read-only merge: match by MAC (create source=pihole devices for unknown MACs), never write iface_status, never delete, idempotent, never create devices from DNS records alone.

nodes.label: UpsertIPAssignment
nodes.rationale: Idempotent IP assignment: insert if absent, else update kind, so a Pi-hole reservation can upgrade dhcp to static without duplicate rows.

nodes.label: Device model/function Fields (Migration 0005)
nodes.rationale: Table-rebuild migration widens the device.kind CHECK (adds router, modem) and adds model/function columns surfaced in dialog, detail, list, and ?q filter.

nodes.label: SetIPKind
nodes.rationale: Store method flipping an assigned IP's kind static/dhcp on user action; unconditional by design (unlike integration upserts).

nodes.label: Static-beats-DHCP Rule
nodes.rationale: Reservations are processed before leases; a claimed (subnetID, ip) set stops a lease from downgrading a static assignment to dhcp while still allowing hostname enrichment.

nodes.label: Transactional Migrations with FK Toggle
nodes.rationale: DROP TABLE during a rebuild with foreign keys ON cascade-deletes child rows; PRAGMA foreign_keys cannot change inside a transaction, so it is toggled OFF around the whole migration pass, each migration runs in a transaction with PRAGMA foreign_key_check, and Open() turns enforcement back on.

nodes.label: Static-to-DHCP Downgrade Guard
nodes.rationale: Integration-driven UpsertIPAssignment must never downgrade an existing static assignment to dhcp (one-line SQL guard) so the periodic Pi-hole sync cannot clobber a user's manual static toggle; the manual SetIPKind stays unconditional.

nodes.label: Token-based Light/Dark Design System
nodes.rationale: app.css rewritten as CSS custom-property tokens (data-theme + prefers-color-scheme) without changing the no-build server-rendered model.

nodes.label: Persisted Theme Toggle
nodes.rationale: No-flash inline bootstrap plus a small embedded theme.js; default dark.

nodes.label: Sortable Dual-view Device Table
nodes.rationale: Sorting is server-side because numeric IP order needs Go; the list/grid toggle is client-side and persisted in localStorage.

nodes.label: Reviewed Flag and Approve Action
nodes.rationale: New device flag (migration 0004) marking scan-discovered devices as reviewed via an Approve action.

nodes.label: Shared deviceTable Templ
nodes.rationale: Devices-page sortable table extracted so the subnet page can reuse it; sort links take a base path parameter, sorting shared via parseDeviceSort.

nodes.label: GroupByParent Helper
nodes.rationale: Reorders device rows to group children under their parent with a per-row depth for indentation.

nodes.label: Shared deviceRow Templ
nodes.rationale: Devices-list table row extracted so the subnet page can render a scoped devices table (devicesInSubnet filter over ListDevices + ListSubnetIfaceIPs) with the same CRUD.

nodes.label: Device-List Parent/Child + Sortable Subnet List Plan (F3)
nodes.norm_label: device-list parent/child + sortable subnet list plan (f3)

nodes.label: Dashboard Widgets Fragment
nodes.rationale: The whole dashboard body is one SSE-refreshed fragment (topics dashboard + events); page and fragment share one assembly function returning DashboardData so they never diverge.

nodes.label: Netis SQLite Data Model
nodes.rationale: subnet/device/interface/ip_assignment/status split so a device can have several NICs and one grid square per IP; device.source field keeps the model agent-ready even though agents were rejected.

nodes.label: Scan Engine (ICMP/ARP sweep pipeline)
nodes.rationale: Offline only after N consecutive missed sweeps (default 3) to avoid flapping from sleeping phones; unprivileged UDP-ICMP fallback when CAP_NET_RAW is absent; ARP/MAC discovery limited to L2 segments the host sits on, remote subnets get ping-only.

nodes.label: SSE Live Updates (HTMX)
nodes.rationale: Server-rendered templ + HTMX with SSE fan-out for live refresh; clients reconnect automatically and the UI stays usable without live updates.

nodes.label: Subnet Grid View
nodes.rationale: The signature view: one square per IP with states used+online, used+offline, reserved, free, conflict derived from ip_assignment + status; squares flip live via SSE during scans.

nodes.label: Full-Range Grid with Edge Squares (AllIPs)
nodes.rationale: Render every address network..broadcast as a dense full-range map; network and broadcast are muted non-clickable edge squares. HostIPs is refactored to call AllIPs then trim edges, keeping its behavior and tests unchanged.

nodes.label: Subnets Index Page (shared subnetRows/subnetCard)
nodes.rationale: Makes grid v2 reachable from a top-nav Subnets entry instead of only dashboard cards. Reuses the dashboard's occupancy computation and card markup by extracting shared subnetRows()/subnetCard so occupancy numbers stay identical between the two pages — one definition, two consumers.

nodes.label: Single Go Monolith Architecture
nodes.rationale: Rejected server + per-segment scanner agents (full MAC coverage but two components and more ops; data model stays agent-ready via device.source) and shelling out to nmap (external dependency in a minimal image). SQLite via modernc.org/sqlite for pure Go, no CGO; assets embedded via go:embed; one static binary.

nodes.label: Reusable Component Set (.card/.pill/.chip/.seg/.dialog)
nodes.rationale: One card definition replaces overlapping .card/.panel/.auth-card/.stat/.badge treatments — fixing them to one definition is what removes the misaligned borders on settings and onboarding. A ships the components so sub-projects B and C become markup-only.

nodes.label: Device Create/Edit Dialog
nodes.rationale: One HTMX fragment (dialog-scrim > dialog, no Layout) injected into a persistent #modal serves both create and edit, replacing the awkward full-page form and scattered per-field forms. Submits as a plain POST; the existing 303 redirect's full-page navigation is the modal-dismiss mechanism.

nodes.label: Icon Picker (DeviceIcon + IconChoices)
nodes.rationale: DeviceIcon returns the chosen icon or the kind default; the kind-change handler replaces the icon only when the current value equals the previous kind's default (untouched), tracked via data-kind-default.

nodes.label: SetDeviceTags Tag Sync
nodes.rationale: Syncs a device's tags to exactly the given names (attach missing, detach removed, find-or-create); idempotent and order-independent. Lives in the store, not the web layer, because it is pure persistence logic. Empty input detaches all tags — the intended clear-tags behavior.

nodes.label: List/Grid View Toggle (localStorage)
nodes.rationale: Client-side toggle persisted in localStorage; both views render the same sorted rows and the script restores the chosen view after each HTMX full re-render.

nodes.label: Device Reviewed Flag + Approve
nodes.rationale: CreateDevice derives reviewed from source (reviewed = source != 'scan') so scan-created devices start as 'new' with no caller changes; UpdateDevice sets reviewed=1 because a human editing a device has reviewed it. Backfill marks existing non-scan devices reviewed.

nodes.label: Design System Foundation & Theme Toggle Design (A)
nodes.norm_label: design system foundation & theme toggle design (a)

nodes.label: Emoji Device Icons
nodes.rationale: Icons are emoji: zero embedded assets, theme-agnostic, universally rendered; the icon picker becomes an emoji palette. A defines the kind-to-default-emoji mapping constant and the .ic tile; B/C consume it.

nodes.label: Theme Toggle (localStorage, no-flash bootstrap)
nodes.rationale: Theme is a personal per-browser preference; localStorage avoids a server round-trip and is correct for the multi-user model (each admin/viewer keeps their own choice) — no store or settings change. Inline head script runs before first paint so a dark-preferring user sees no light flash; default dark. try/catch around localStorage falls back to the media query so a theme always renders.

nodes.label: WireGuard Integration (SSH wg show dump)
nodes.rationale: WireGuard runs on a remote host, so netis connects via SSH and parses wg show dump; peer online = handshake under 3 minutes; WireGuard subnets are never swept.

nodes.label: Pi-hole v6 API Client
nodes.rationale: Session auth: logs in on demand, caches the SID, sends X-FTL-SID; on 401 re-authenticates once and retries, a second 401 is an error. Malformed entries skipped, not fatal.

nodes.label: Pi-hole Reconciliation Sync
nodes.rationale: Never touches iface_status: a DHCP lease means 'has an address', not 'is online' — liveness stays the scanner's responsibility so the two never conflict. Reservations processed before leases so static wins over dhcp for the same MAC. DNS records never create MAC-less phantom devices. Idempotent; never deletes.

nodes.label: UpsertIPAssignment Store Method
nodes.rationale: Select-then-update/insert provides both idempotency and the dhcp-to-static upgrade path; SetIfaceHostnameIfEmpty never overwrites an existing hostname.

nodes.label: Per-IP Lease Toggle (detail page)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the grid-cell toggle; reuses store.SetIPKind. Only IPs with a subnet assignment get the toggle since SetIPKind keys on subnet+ip; one exported LeaseToggle templ serves both the page and the handler fragment.

nodes.label: Model & Function Device Fields (migration 0005)
nodes.rationale: Model and function are first-class device columns (not custom fields) so they are sortable/filterable with dedicated inputs; function is one free-text field holding role + channel together. Vendor becomes user-editable: scan fills it only when it creates an unknown device and never updates existing rows, so a user edit is never clobbered. Explicit INSERT column list guards against silent column drift in the rebuild.

nodes.label: Static/DHCP Lease Kind Toggle (SetIPKind)
nodes.rationale: Two visual axes: fill color = occupancy/liveness (free/reserved/online/offline/conflict), border = lease kind (solid static, dashed dhcp). Toggle limited to static-vs-dhcp on already-assigned IPs; reserve/free needs placeholder device handling and is out of scope. No schema change — ip_assignment.kind already carries the CHECK.

nodes.label: Non-Downgrading UpsertIPAssignment (static wins)
nodes.rationale: Integration-driven assignment is not authoritative over a user's explicit static choice: UpsertIPAssignment's UPDATE never downgrades static to dhcp, while the manual SetIPKind toggle stays unconditional so users can flip both directions. The dhcp-to-static reservation upgrade path is preserved. Chosen over provenance-tracking columns as sufficient for the reported bug.

nodes.label: integration_status Table & Store
nodes.rationale: Sync/scan status was invisible to the web layer (each Sync kept an in-memory failing bool); persist per-integration status through the store the background loops already hold — no new shared objects plumbed between loops and web server. RunOnce changes to return per-package Stats so loops can record counts.

nodes.label: Periodic Integration Hot-Reload
nodes.rationale: Reuses the run-now closures on a per-integration ticker: each tick reads current settings, so configuring or changing an integration takes effect within a minute with no restart. An unconfigured integration returns errNotConfigured, records nothing, and is retried next tick — self-healing once settings are saved.

nodes.label: IntegrationRunner Registry
nodes.rationale: Run synchronously in the handler with a ~20s context timeout; no per-integration concurrency guard because RunOnce writes are idempotent upserts and overlap with the poller is an accepted low risk. The registry lives in main so the web package never imports proxmox/pihole/wireguard; s.runner may be nil for tests.

nodes.label: Integration Run-now Button + Toast Feedback
nodes.rationale: The button always shows; the handler reads the just-recorded IntegrationStatus and toasts connected/failing/not-configured — useful feedback even on failure.

nodes.label: newIntegrationRunner (current-settings closures)
nodes.rationale: Root cause: the boot-time registry only registered integrations configured at startup, so an integration configured later toasted 'not configured' despite saved settings. All three integrations register unconditionally with closures that read current settings on each call and return errNotConfigured when the URL is empty — run-now works immediately after saving, no restart.

nodes.label: Integration Status Pill (connected/failing)
nodes.rationale: Display the last poller result rather than a live Test-connection button: integration config applies on restart, so the recorded status reflects the running config. Four states: connected (with last-worked relTime), failing, configured-not-run-yet, not configured.

nodes.label: Device Detail Hero + Two-Column Layout
nodes.rationale: Template + CSS reorganization only: hero header card over interfaces-left / metadata-aside columns; no route, handler, or view-model change so all existing DevicePage test assertions keep passing.

nodes.label: Server-side Device Sorting
nodes.rationale: Sorting is server-side because numeric IP order requires Go (netip.ParseAddr + Addr.Compare) — a string sort would misorder .2/.10/.100. Unknown sort/dir values fall back to defaults, never a 500; devices with no IP sort last.

nodes.label: Shared Sortable deviceTable (base-path links)
nodes.rationale: Both features hinge on one refactor: extract the sortable table into a reusable component whose sort links take a base path, so it renders on both /devices and /subnets/{id} with sort links staying on the hosting page.

nodes.label: GroupByParent Tree Grouping
nodes.rationale: Stable DFS preserving the applied sort within sibling sets; an orphan whose parent is filtered out is treated as a root so no row is ever dropped; a visited set guards cyclic parent references guaranteeing termination. Only the Devices page is grouped — the subnet list is a filtered subset where the parent is often absent, so it stays flat; grid tiles stay flat as a spatial overview.

nodes.label: Devices-in-Subnet Scoped List
nodes.rationale: Shows devices with an IP assigned in this subnet (matching the grid) by filtering ListDevices against ListSubnetIfaceIPs — no new store query. Reuses the exact devices-list row markup via a shared deviceRow templ. A scope note clarifies why the grid shows fewer devices than the full /devices total.

nodes.label: Device-List Parent/Child + Sortable Subnet List Design (F3)
nodes.norm_label: device-list parent/child + sortable subnet list design (f3)

nodes.label: Quick Fixes Design (F1: nav order + run-now)
nodes.norm_label: quick fixes design (f1: nav order + run-now)

nodes.label: Subnet Page Devices List + CRUD Design (E2)
nodes.norm_label: subnet page devices list + crud design (e2)

nodes.label: New-subnet Defaults in General Settings
nodes.rationale: Defaults (scan interval, subnet kind, auto-scan) persist via handleGeneralSave and prefill the Add-subnet form; no schema change.

nodes.label: netdetect Subnet Auto-detection
nodes.rationale: Pure package listing scannable IPv4 subnets from host interfaces with an injectable lister for tests.

nodes.label: Settings Tabs
nodes.rationale: Server-rendered tabs (Subnets/Integrations/Users/General) with the integrations save loop and fieldset markup extracted for reuse.

nodes.label: First-run Quick-setup Wizard
nodes.rationale: Gated by a new 'onboarded' setting after admin creation, enforced by a redirect in the auth middleware.

nodes.label: onboardShell Branded Stepper
nodes.rationale: Shared brand hero + 3-step stepper + card shell for Setup and Welcome; all view signatures, endpoints, and field names stay identical so handlers and tests are untouched.

nodes.label: Hot-loaded Integration Poller Settings
nodes.rationale: Periodic pollers read current settings each tick so integration config applies within a minute without restart, replacing boot-time Sync.Start blocks.

nodes.label: Run-now Runner Registry
nodes.rationale: Runner interface lives in web, concrete map wired in main, so the settings handler can trigger a configured integration's RunOnce and toast the recorded IntegrationStatus result.

nodes.label: newIntegrationRunner Closures
nodes.rationale: Extracts main.go's run-now registry into closures that read the store's current settings on each run, so Run-now works without a restart.

nodes.label: Toast HTML Fragments
nodes.rationale: Handlers return a small toast fragment appended into a #toasts container by HTMX; POST /scan triggers every non-WireGuard subnet.

nodes.label: audit_log Table (Migration 0013)
nodes.rationale: status column distinguishes refused from effective requests; username snapshot survives deletion.

nodes.label: Server.audit Route-pattern Middleware
nodes.rationale: Keyed on r.Pattern so later mutating routes are covered automatically; never logs form values.

nodes.label: SetUserRoleGuarded
nodes.rationale: Single guarded UPDATE refuses demoting last admin atomically, like DeleteUserGuarded.

nodes.label: Backup Scheduler (internal/backup)
nodes.rationale: Server snapshots on its own so installs need no cron; startup seeds last success to avoid backup per restart.

nodes.label: Store.VacuumInto (VACUUM INTO)
nodes.rationale: Live connection safe under WAL; avoids second handle racing server.

nodes.label: Temp File + fsync + Rename
nodes.rationale: Crash never leaves half-written file under a backup name.

nodes.label: Subnet DHCP Pool (dhcp_start/dhcp_end)
nodes.rationale: Next free IP previously fell inside router pool, colliding with leases.

nodes.label: A4 device form suggestions (datalists, Use detected)
nodes.norm_label: a4 device form suggestions (datalists, use detected)

nodes.label: Tag palette (slate..sand, contrast-checked)
nodes.rationale: No status hues or accent blue; 4.5:1 contrast in both themes.

nodes.label: ResolveName (rDNS + mDNS PTR)
nodes.rationale: Name lookup falls back to unicast mDNS PTR query; negative results cached 30 min.

nodes.label: Presence Without ICMP (ARP + TCP fallback)
nodes.rationale: ICMP-silent hosts answer ARP; TCP connect to 6 ports or ARP recheck after 9s confirms presence; netlink NUD rejected as not worth parser.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions version updates
nodes.rationale: Workflows pin action majors which go stale quietly (Node 20 deprecation noticed by hand).

nodes.label: go-minor-and-patch Dependabot group
nodes.rationale: Grouped so a routine bump is one PR; majors arrive alone because those are worth reading.

nodes.label: CI job (vet, staticcheck, race tests, govulncheck, build)
nodes.norm_label: ci job (vet, staticcheck, race tests, govulncheck, build)
nodes.rationale: Store queries run on both backends so the suite runs on SQLite and Postgres.

nodes.label: Docker build-only job
nodes.rationale: Catches a broken Dockerfile before a release tag is cut, using the same build args as release.

nodes.label: e2e job (Playwright visual + a11y)
nodes.rationale: Playwright runs in a pinned image so rendering matches committed baselines.

nodes.label: Static binary release job
nodes.rationale: README sells netis as a single static binary; previously releases shipped only a container image.

nodes.label: Release test gate
nodes.rationale: A tag can point at a commit CI never saw, so the release runs the suite itself before publishing.

nodes.label: Make targets (build, test, test-pg, e2e, screenshots)
nodes.norm_label: make targets (build, test, test-pg, e2e, screenshots)

nodes.label: Visual regression tests (Playwright + axe)
nodes.rationale: Fixture server with fixed data and frozen clock so relative times render identically.

nodes.label: netis (home LAN inventory)
nodes.rationale: Single static Go binary with embedded SQLite, no external services required.

nodes.label: leases.Apply (internal/leases)
nodes.rationale: Lease-apply half of pihole.Sync.RunOnce moved unchanged so all lease sources share rules.

nodes.label: OPNsense Integration (internal/opnsense)
nodes.rationale: Asks Kea, ISC, Dnsmasq in order; uses first that answers with leases because Kea API returns empty on ISC installs.

nodes.label: Directed Wake-on-LAN (wol.DirectedBroadcast/Targets/SendAll)
nodes.rationale: Limited broadcast only leaves default-route iface; subnet prefix defines directed broadcast.

nodes.label: Store.ReconcileUpstream
nodes.rationale: Only reconcile on authoritative non-empty runs; empty list treated as cannot-tell to avoid mass flagging.

nodes.label: Store.SyncIntegrationIPs
nodes.rationale: Never touches or relabels rows of another source; user rows stay the user's.

nodes.label: OPNsense ARP Enrichment
nodes.rationale: Fills MAC on MAC-less ifaces on routed VLANs before leases to avoid duplicates; only unique MACs.

nodes.label: Device Rebuild Keeps Added Columns Test
nodes.norm_label: device rebuild keeps added columns test

nodes.label: More DHCP Lease Sources (AdGuard Home, OPNsense) Design
nodes.norm_label: more dhcp lease sources (adguard home, opnsense) design

nodes.label: Directed Wake-on-LAN and Stale Integration Devices (F6) Design
nodes.norm_label: directed wake-on-lan and stale integration devices (f6) design

nodes.label: Per-integration Device Source Values
nodes.rationale: Chose adguard/opnsense sources over generic dhcp: users want to know which box reported a device.

nodes.label: Personal API tokens
nodes.rationale: Shown once, only SHA-256 digest stored; acts with owner's role.

nodes.label: Login rate limiter
nodes.rationale: Without trusted proxies all users key to the proxy address and lock each other out.

nodes.label: OIDC single sign-on (PKCE)
nodes.rationale: SSO users matched by issuer+subject, never username, to prevent account takeover.

nodes.label: Batch 4 features F1-F7 (alerts, API tokens, discovery, backups, audit, WoL, mDNS/OIDC)
nodes.norm_label: batch 4 features f1-f7 (alerts, api tokens, discovery, backups, audit, wol, mdns/oidc)

nodes.label: Migrations in both sqlite and postgres dirs
nodes.norm_label: migrations in both sqlite and postgres dirs
nodes.rationale: Store queries must run on both backends; use s.exec/s.query, never s.DB.

nodes.label: Q7 SSE revocation and sha256 session tokens
nodes.norm_label: q7 sse revocation and sha256 session tokens

nodes.label: Background scan loop (ping sweep + ARP read)
nodes.norm_label: background scan loop (ping sweep + arp read)

nodes.label: Missing upstream badge
nodes.rationale: Only marked after a successful non-empty sync, since a token that lost permissions sees no guests.

nodes.label: Integration sync runner (once a minute, Run now, 30s cutoff)
nodes.norm_label: integration sync runner (once a minute, run now, 30s cutoff)

nodes.label: Q2 single integration runner with status and lock
nodes.norm_label: q2 single integration runner with status and lock

nodes.label: CSV import with preview
nodes.rationale: Known MAC only fills missing fields; tags added never removed, so an export can be re-imported as is.

nodes.label: Prometheus /metrics endpoint
nodes.rationale: Not left open without a token because metrics name every subnet and count every device.

nodes.label: Notification batching (30s, bounded queue)
nodes.rationale: A scan finding fifty devices sends one summary; sending never holds up a scan.

nodes.label: JSON API, export and metrics doc
nodes.norm_label: json api, export and metrics doc

nodes.label: Filling in device details (autofill)
nodes.rationale: Only fills empty fields and never changes a user-set value; once edited a field is the user's.

nodes.label: Docker with --network host
nodes.rationale: Needed to read host ARP table for MACs and to hear mDNS/UPnP answers.

nodes.label: autofill.Service (Run, Kick, Start)
nodes.rationale: Coalesced full pass kicked after sweeps and integration runs; never fails a sweep.

nodes.label: autofill.Resolve / decide / Explain
nodes.rationale: Hints below confidence 50 stored but not applied; source rank mdns>ssdp>ports>hostname>oui.

nodes.label: probe.SearchSSDP (UPnP description fetch)
nodes.rationale: Description fetched only when LOCATION host equals responder, no redirects, 64 KiB cap.

nodes.label: netis backup (VACUUM INTO snapshot)
nodes.rationale: cp is unsafe under WAL; snapshot opens source read-only and never migrates.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL backend
nodes.rationale: Worth it when DB must live outside the container or be backed up by existing infra.

nodes.label: Scheduled backups
nodes.rationale: Written under temp name and renamed so a crash never leaves a half-written backup; first backup due one interval after newest.

nodes.label: SQLite backend
nodes.rationale: Right default for a single instance: a file, no server, binary stays static.

nodes.label: AES-256-GCM credential encryption
nodes.rationale: Only credential rows encrypted; key never in DB so keep it with backups.

nodes.label: netis limitations (L2 MAC discovery, /16 cap, on-demand port scans)
nodes.norm_label: netis limitations (l2 mac discovery, /16 cap, on-demand port scans)

nodes.label: hashToken (SHA-256 hex)
nodes.rationale: Copied DB or backup carries no working credential; plain digest suffices for 256-bit random value.

nodes.label: Personal API Tokens (netis_ prefix)
nodes.rationale: Prefix makes leaked tokens recognisable to secret scanners; plaintext shown once.

nodes.label: Bearer Authentication on /api/*
nodes.rationale: Bearer requests skip Origin check/CrossOriginProtection: no ambient credential to forge.

nodes.label: Inventory Export (JSON/CSV)
nodes.rationale: Cells starting with = + - @ are prefixed with ' to prevent spreadsheet formula injection.

nodes.label: API Tokens, Write API, Export and CSV Import (F2) Design
nodes.norm_label: api tokens, write api, export and csv import (f2) design

nodes.label: Enrich, Don't Clobber Rule
nodes.rationale: Updates fill empty fields only; name/kind replaced only on unreviewed scan devices; guards in SQL too.

nodes.label: Randomized (Private) MAC Detection (macaddr.IsPrivate)
nodes.rationale: Locally-administered bit 0x02; QEMU 52:54:00 and Docker 02:42 excluded.

nodes.label: autofill.Resolve
nodes.rationale: Highest confidence wins; ties by source rank mdns>ssdp>ports>hostname>oui; threshold 50.

nodes.label: A3 SSDP/UPnP Source
nodes.rationale: LOCATION fetched only from responder's own IP, no redirects, 2s, 64KiB cap.

nodes.label: Autofill Apply Rules / Field Ownership
nodes.rationale: Never overwrite a person's value; a user change marks the field owned forever.

nodes.label: IBM Plex Sans/Mono Self-hosted
nodes.rationale: No CDN: offline homelab and CSP.

nodes.label: Patch Panel Subnet Grid
nodes.rationale: Rack vocabulary: status colour means status, as an LED does.

nodes.label: Port Hover Card
nodes.rationale: Replaces slow, unstyled, keyboard-unreachable title tooltip.

nodes.label: Seven-hue Tag Palette (auto via fnv32a)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over dot style (looks like status LED) and free picker (contrast not guaranteed).

nodes.label: Notifier (internal/notify)
nodes.rationale: Bounded async queue (256) so Notify never blocks Emit; filtering needs DB reads so it runs on the worker.

nodes.label: store.SecretSettings (encrypted at rest under NETIS_SECRET_KEY)
nodes.rationale: Secrets never echoed back; blank field keeps stored value.

nodes.label: Per-device Alert-When-Offline Flag
nodes.rationale: Default off; kept separate from UpdateDevice so syncs and edit form never touch it.

nodes.label: ip_conflict Event Type
nodes.rationale: Emitted once per IP on transition into conflict after a subnet sweep; set held in memory.

nodes.label: ntfy Notification Channel
nodes.rationale: Gotify skipped: ntfy covers self-hosted push; Gotify reachable via webhook bridge.

nodes.label: 30s Notification Coalescing Window
nodes.rationale: A scan finding 50 devices sends one summary message instead of 50.

nodes.label: Subnets (CIDR, scan interval)
nodes.rationale: Max 65,536 addresses because every address becomes a grid cell and sweep target; refused at save.

nodes.label: Free-for-static rule (freeSummary, grid free/pool states)
nodes.rationale: Free never includes a pool address, in any view.

nodes.label: OIDC Identity Mapping (iss, sub)
nodes.rationale: Match only on (iss, sub); never attach to existing account by name to prevent admin takeover via preferred_username.

nodes.label: netis_oidc Signed Cookie
nodes.rationale: SameSite=Lax so IdP redirect back passes; HMAC signed to stop tampering with state/nonce/link target.

nodes.label: OIDC Environment Configuration
nodes.rationale: Client secret in env not settings table; half-configured SSO is a startup error.

nodes.label: Break-glass Local Admin Password Login
nodes.rationale: Disable-password still lets local admins in when IdP is down.

nodes.label: Lazy OIDC Discovery
nodes.rationale: IdP down at startup does not block netis.
